news.title: New minor risk - Profit margin trend
news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 0.2% Last year net profit margin: 2.5% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.1x net interest cover). Minor Risks Large one-off items impacting financial results. Profit margins are more than 30% lower than last year

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹2.48 loss per share (vs ₹0.58 profit in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹2.48 loss per share (down from ₹0.58 profit in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.24b (up 21% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹79.6m (down ₹97.3m from profit in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 2% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 36% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
